C-RELEASE-CASK-SIGNED-DIGEST.IntentSummary: Close the cask-digest ambiguity C-RELEASE-SIGNING-SPLIT left downstream: since the split (#315, commit 3f61c2b7) a stable run carries the Mark_${VER}_aarch64.dmg.sha256 sidecar filename in three artifacts holding two different values — mark-macos-arm64-release-staged with the digest of the UNSIGNED staged DMG, mark-macos-arm64-release with the fresh digest of the SIGNED DMG re-emitted by the sign job, and the release-publication-${TAG} inventory with a copy of the signed digest — while publish-cask downloads ALL run artifacts (no pattern/name, v4 unpacks each artifact into its own subdirectory) and picks the sidecar with an unconstrained find /tmp/release-stage -name "Mark_${VER}_aarch64.dmg.sha256" | head -1 whose result nothing downstream re-checks before it is written into the public Homebrew cask. The fix: publish-cask downloads exactly mark-macos-arm64-release by name into its own path /tmp/release-stage/mark-macos-arm64-release (the job's only staged-tree read is that sidecar — the tap lives in /tmp/tap — so the narrowing loses nothing), addresses the sidecar and the signed DMG beside it by their explicit artifact-subdirectory paths with a fail-closed existence check, deletes the unconstrained find/head selection from the workflow, and adds a fail-closed coherence check before gh auth setup-git and any cask mutation: sha256sum over the signed DMG compared with the sidecar value, refusing with ::error::[ReleaseCask][publish-cask][BLOCK_RELEASE_CASK_DIGEST_MISMATCH] and exit 1 on mismatch; the cask still carries the sidecar value per B2CR-3 — the hash is only a coherence check, never substituted. The other /tmp/release-stage consumers are audited and correct (prepare-publication downloads with pattern: mark-*-release, which cannot match the -staged names, and its copy_one guard fails closed unless the find returns exactly one match; the feed-fragment find consumes every match intentionally) and stay untouched. tests/renderer/release-governance.test.js gains the comment-blind red-control validator assertCaskSignedDigest with CRLF-tolerant regexes, a positive pin test and a red-control test whose in-memory mutations restore the broad unnamed download, remove the coherence check, reintroduce the unconstrained find and swallow the comparison, each asserted to throw; docs/release-process.md 4b gains the signed-set/coherence sentences; release.yml bumps to VERSION 3.10.0 with a dated CHANGE_SUMMARY line and the publish-cask MODULE_MAP entry; the test file bumps to 2.5.0; .grace/graph/features.xml M-046 gains one dated SummaryDelta and .grace/verification/features.xml V-M-046 gains scenario-40.
